facts.text: Franklin County was organized on January 15, 1851, and named after the American polymath Benjamin Franklin.
The county seat, Hampton, hosts the historic Franklin County Courthouse, built in 1891 and listed on the National Register in 1976.
Every mid‑July, the Franklin County Fair turns the west side of Hampton into a five‑day celebration featuring rodeo, concerts, and figure‑8 races.
The fairgrounds also house the Franklin County Historical Museum, a turn‑of‑the‑century village called Pleasant Hill with old‑west shows and music.
Grandpa's Farm on the fairgrounds demonstrates every phase of farming, from draft‑horse‑powered implements to antique tractors and steam engines.
Franklin County sits in north‑central Iowa, bordered by Cerro Gordo to the north, Butler to the east, Hardin to the south, and Wright to the west.
